notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]First, thank you for all your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]I’ve changed the death penalty balancing from yesterday’s patch and moved it to a new menu option called [b]“Easy Mode.”[/b] Now you can choose whether you want to be completely reset after death or just sent back two floors. I think this is a much better solution, thanks for the input![/p][p][/p][p]As you can see in the picture below, I also added a diagram with Jim that explains the task cycle. I wanted to replace the big wall of text with something more fitting for the whiteboard and less overwhelming to read.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649071/e0cfa806e954e3e4f78ee57e6c5b9d3367a9ff00.png"][/img][/p][p]I think this will be the last small patch before the bigger content update in about 3–4 weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a great weekend![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Game Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]In this small patch, I’ve adjusted the penalty for dying. The probability of an anomaly occurring that kills you is highest in the last two theater halls, and I noticed it was quite frustrating to be thrown completely back to the start.[/p][p]It should still feel like a challenge, though. Just like the Whiteboard says, you need to avoid those dangers. That’s why I’ve changed it so you’re no longer sent all the way back to Cinema Hall 8 after dying. Instead, you now have to redo three extra halls.[/p][p]For example, if you die in Hall 1, you’ll be sent back to Hall 4.[/p][p]I’ve also updated the Whiteboard instructions with a warning that dying will result in a penalty of extra work.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope this makes the challenge feel more balanced and fair than before. Thanks for playing and please leave your feedback in the comments![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Games Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]First, a big thanks to the people who made me aware of these two little bugs![/p][p]The first bug was that you could walk out of the map in the back corner of the theater.
The second was a minor display error: on the finish screen, the statistic for [i]“Decided for flaw but there wasn’t one”[/i] almost always showed 0 because the wrong statistic was being displayed.[/p][p]Both are now fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a great weekend![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Game Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]first of all, in this small patch I adjusted the lighting in the cinema a little. It’s no longer quite as dark in the backseats, but still dark enough. The reason for this change is that many players had trouble seeing where they could walk, and for some anomalies you need to take different paths.[/p][p][/p][p]Before Halloween, I’m planning a bigger content update. This should be released no later than October 24, and maybe even a few days earlier. As you can see in the picture with these update notes, there will be a new character in the content update: the mom of Jim and Olivia, along with a lot of other new stuff![/p][p][/p][p]Have a great week![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Game Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]with this small patch I tried to reduce the heavy lag that occurred when entering the cinema entrance and the theater for the first time. It should be much less noticeable now, but I’ll keep working on optimizing performance further.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, and have a nice day![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Game Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]before I talk about the small change in this patch, I want to hear your ideas for a content update (1.1.0) that I’m planning before the spooky season of Halloween!
This update should include some more anomaly references from horror and non-horror movie classics, as well as more clip flaws and maybe other small things for the popcorn guy to do.[/p][p]So please share your ideas in the comments, either just mention a movie you think would be great to see, or even suggest how I should integrate it if you have something in mind. Many thanks in advance![/p][p][/p][p]Now, for the change in this patch: I noticed a lot of players were getting confused by the fog anomaly reference to [i]The Mist[/i], which is totally understandable if you didn’t program it yourself and don’t know what to do. To help, I added a voice line and a corresponding subtitle after you get teleported into the fog, giving you a clue about what to do next.[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve really learned a lot on my game dev journey from everyone who has played the game. The most important lesson and one I always need to remember, is that the things I develop are completely clear to me only because they came from my own head. I need to explain them in some way so everyone else can understand what I intended.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the learning and support![/p][p]Marten
Struggle Game Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]The first change in this patch is that when you reach Cinema Hall 0, the Popcorn Guy now guides you a bit more clearly toward the manuscript. The manuscript contains some backstory and lore behind the clip and its characters. Since I noticed many players were passing by Hall 0 without noticing it, I wanted to make it more visible. The manuscript can now also be found in the backroom near the camera projector, once you’ve finished the game at least once.[/p][p]I also made a few minor adjustments to hopefully reduce occasional frame drops, along with some translation optimizations.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all your support![/p][p][i]Marten[/i]
[b]Struggle Games Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]Over the last couple of days since release, I’ve been watching a lot of your streams and videos of [i]One Last Clip[/i], as well as reading your comments. Two of the most requested quality-of-life features are now included in this patch:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Skip Hall 8 after reset[/b]
When you get reset to Hall 8 (because of death or a wrong decision), you can now open the normal exit instead of being forced to rewatch the correct clip you may have already seen many times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Separate Jumpscare Volume[/b]
You can now adjust the volume of jumpscares independently. Previously, jumpscares were tied to sound effects and often came across as a little too loud. Now you can set it exactly how you like.[/p][/*][/olist][p]I also fixed a rare issue where the [b]Popcorn Guy[/b] sometimes spawned in the wrong place, got stuck in the ground, or behaved oddly. On top of that, he now has a proper collider, so players can no longer walk through him in certain situations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Known Issue[/b]
In some cases, the chairs may open right after starting the clip, or show other incorrect behavior. I’ve seen this happen in playthroughs, but I haven’t been able to reproduce it myself yet. I’m still investigating so I can pinpoint and fix it.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all your support and the super helpful feedback it really helps me make the game even better![/p][p][i]Marten[/i]
[b]Struggle Games Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]First, a [b]BIG thank you[/b] to everyone who has already played [i]One Last Clip[/i]! I really appreciate it to see so many people having fun with the game.[/p][p][/p][p]In this first small update, I’ve balanced some of the anomalies that can kill you. I either increased the reaction time or reduced the waiting time. Before, if you didn’t fully understand what was happening, the timing felt unfair, and dying often seemed inevitable without a lot of trial and error.[/p][p]Next, I worked on making the text hints on the board a bit clearer, but still without directly explaining everything to the player. They now clarify that the anomalies in the cinema don’t affect your choices, and they also give small tips on how to survive the deadly anomalies.[/p][p]I also fixed a small bug where the [b]“Clown/It” Anomaly[/b] was very difficult to trigger, which made the related achievement nearly impossible to unlock. On top of that, I’ve upgraded Unity (the game engine) to the newest stable version, so everything stays up to date.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p][p][i]Marten[/i]
[b]Struggle Games Studio[/b][/p]
